byte_protocol.canonical_json_bytes: UTF8(JSON with keys sorted lexicographically, separators comma and colon, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; duplicate keys rejected before canonicalization)
byte_protocol.document_hash: SHA256(UTF8(document_hash_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(document_type) || 0x00 || canonical_json(document with document_sha256 and signatures omitted))
byte_protocol.signature_message: UTF8(signature_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(document_type) || 0x00 || ASCII(role) || 0x00 || ASCII(key_id) || 0x00 || HEX_DECODE(signature_subject_by_document value); signature.signed_sha256 must equal that subject
byte_protocol.organization_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(organization_commitment_domain) || 0x00 || UINT32_BE(random_salt_byte_length) || random_salt || UTF8(exact organization identity descriptor)); random_salt_byte_length >= 16 and salt/descriptor remain out of band
byte_protocol.observation_source_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(observation_source_commitment_domain) || 0x00 || UINT32_BE(random_salt_byte_length) || random_salt || UTF8(exact observation-source descriptor)); random_salt_byte_length >= 16 and salt/descriptor remain out of band
byte_protocol.user_authorization_binding_sha256: SHA256(UTF8(user_authorization_binding_domain) || 0x00 || canonical_json(authorization grant with explicit_user_authorization_binding_sha256, document_sha256 and signatures omitted))
byte_protocol.canonical_case_digest: SHA256(UTF8(canonical_case_digest_domain) || 0x00 || canonical_json({task_schema_version, user_input, tools} from one unseen-case-bundle case; case_handle excluded))
byte_protocol.seen_task_exclusion_set_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(seen_task_exclusion_set_domain) || 0x00 || canonical_json(sorted unique lowercase SHA256 task digests))
byte_protocol.seen_source_inventory_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(seen_task_exclusion_set_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(source_inventory) || 0x00 || canonical_json(source inventory ordered by the contract source-class order))
byte_protocol.case_handle_set_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(case_handle_set_domain) || 0x00 || canonical_json(sorted unique opaque case handles))
byte_protocol.execution_input_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(execution_input_commitment_domain) || 0x00 || UINT32_BE(secret_salt_byte_length) || secret_salt || canonical_json({case_handle, task_schema_version, user_input, max_turns_per_case, tools, leak_canary_b64, runner_config_commitment_sha256})); secret salt, canary and plaintext are held only by the custodian-side in-memory verifier
byte_protocol.execution_input_order_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(execution_input_order_domain) || 0x00 || canonical_json(ordered lowercase execution_input_commitment_sha256 values in runtime case-handle order))
byte_protocol.audit_request_summary_sha256: SHA256(canonical_json({campaign_id, case_handle, execution_input_commitment_sha256, external_plan_binding_sha256, authorization_grant_sha256, provider_id, model_id, api_surface, transport_id}))
byte_protocol.planned_audit_run_set_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(audit_run_set_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(planned) || 0x00 || canonical_json(all ordered derived audit run IDs))
byte_protocol.observed_audit_run_set_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(audit_run_set_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(observed) || 0x00 || canonical_json(the exact observed prefix of ordered derived audit run IDs))
byte_protocol.denominator_plan_commitment: SHA256(canonical_json(exact runtime_plan.denominator_plan object, whose field set equals runtime_plan_contract.denominator_plan_projection_fields))
byte_protocol.budget_policy_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(runtime_plan_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(budget_policy) || 0x00 || canonical_json(runtime_plan.budget_policy with budget_policy_commitment_sha256 omitted))
byte_protocol.closure_reasons_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(closure_receipt_hash_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(closure_reasons) || 0x00 || canonical_json(fixed-order deduplicated closure reasons))
byte_protocol.ordered_final_chain_heads_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(audit_run_set_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(final_chain_heads) || 0x00 || canonical_json(ordered objects with run_id and final_chain_head_sha256))
byte_protocol.ledger_entry_hash: SHA256(UTF8(ledger_entry_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(ledger_id) || 0x00 || UINT64_BE(sequence) || HEX_DECODE(previous_head_sha256) || canonical_json(entry with entry_sha256, resulting_head_sha256 and signatures omitted))
byte_protocol.integer_encoding: unsigned big-endian with exact width stated by each formula
byte_protocol.hash_hex_encoding: lowercase hexadecimal unless an identifier formula explicitly requires uppercase
byte_protocol.external_document_and_case_identifier_fo: fixed PCE prefix plus 32 uppercase hexadecimal characters (128 bits); duplicates are rejected before commitment or consumption

envelope_contract.timestamp_relation_policy: operators in cross_document_timeline are normative: less-than is strict and less-than-or-equal permits equality
envelope_contract.timestamp_text_semantics: exact Gregorian UTC text YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z with uppercase T and Z, seconds 00 through 59, one or more fractional digits when the decimal point is present, arbitrary fractional precision preserved for comparison, and leap-second 60 rejected

cross_document_timeline.trust_precondition: trust.valid_from_utc <= trust.created_at_utc <= candidate_freeze.frozen_at_utc and candidate_freeze.frozen_at_utc < trust.expires_at_utc
cross_document_timeline.strict_order_before_task_access: trust.created_at_utc <= trust_observation.observed_at_utc <= candidate_freeze.frozen_at_utc < candidate_frozen_entry.occurred_at_utc <= candidate_anchor.observed_at_utc < seen_exclusion_manifest.created_at_utc < envelope.task_bundle_committed_at_utc < envelope.envelope_frozen_at_utc < preregistration_frozen_entry.occurred_at_utc <= preregistration_anchor.observed_at_utc < user_authorization_observation.observed_at_utc <= grant.authorized_at_utc <= grant.not_before_utc <= consumption.consumed_at_utc < authorization_consumed_entry.occurred_at_utc <= authorization_consumed_anchor.observed_at_utc
cross_document_timeline.network_and_completion_order: each non-null release/key time <= closure_receipt.completed_at_utc; if sends exist, each non-null release/key time <= every transport_send.occurred_at_utc <= closure_receipt.completed_at_utc; completed_at_utc < receipt_issued_at_utc < closure_evidence_anchored_entry.occurred_at_utc
cross_document_timeline.any_transport_send_requires_prior_releas: if any transport_send exists, closure_receipt.task_released and provider_key_loaded must both be true, both timestamps must be non-null, and authorization_consumed_entry.occurred_at_utc < both timestamps <= every transport_send.occurred_at_utc
cross_document_timeline.expiry_order: closure_receipt.completed_at_utc < grant.expires_at_utc and closure_receipt.receipt_issued_at_utc < closure_evidence_anchored_entry.occurred_at_utc <= final_anchor.observed_at_utc <= envelope.valid_until_utc
cross_document_timeline.external_anchor_observation_order: trust.created_at_utc <= trust observation observed_at_utc <= candidate freeze; each ledger entry_occurred_at_utc <= its anchor observed_at_utc; candidate anchor observed_at_utc < seen manifest creation and task_bundle_committed_at_utc; preregistration anchor observed_at_utc < user authorization observation observed_at_utc <= grant.authorized_at_utc; authorization-consumed anchor observed_at_utc < each task release, key load and transport send time; closure entry_occurred_at_utc <= final anchor observed_at_utc

runtime_plan_contract.budget_policy_commitment_projection: exact runtime_plan.budget_policy JSON object with only budget_policy_commitment_sha256 omitted
runtime_plan_contract.money_encoding: positive base-10 decimal string with exactly six fractional digits
runtime_plan_contract.observed_cost_encoding: nonnegative base-10 decimal string with exactly twelve fractional digits and at most eighteen integer digits

entry_document_hash_exact_projection.candidate_freeze_receipt_sha256: computed candidate_freeze_receipt.document_sha256 and identical in every later entry
entry_document_hash_exact_projection.preregistration_envelope_sha256: computed preregistration_envelope.document_sha256 and identical in preregistration_frozen plus every later entry
entry_document_hash_exact_projection.authorization_grant_sha256: computed authorization_grant.document_sha256 and identical in authorization_consumed plus closure_evidence_anchored
entry_document_hash_exact_projection.consumption_receipt_sha256: computed consumption_receipt.document_sha256 and identical in authorization_consumed plus closure_evidence_anchored
entry_document_hash_exact_projection.closure_receipt_sha256: computed closure_receipt.document_sha256 and present only in closure_evidence_anchored

grant_exact_cross_projection.explicit_user_authorization_id_sha256: out_of_band user authorization observation ID hash
grant_exact_cross_projection.explicit_user_authorization_binding_sha2: recomputed binding and out_of_band user authorization observation binding hash

authorization_grant_contract.user_authorization_binding_projection: exact authorization grant JSON object with only explicit_user_authorization_binding_sha256, document_sha256 and signatures omitted

closure_evidence_contract.closure_receipt_unsigned_body_projection: exact closure receipt JSON object with only document_sha256 and signatures omitted
closure_evidence_contract.timeline_order: grant.not_before <= consumption.consumed_at < authorization_consumed_entry.occurred_at; every non-null task release/key time <= completed_at and, when sends exist, <= every send <= completed_at; completed_at < grant.expires_at; manifest observation is after the artifact stage and before receipt_issued_at; receipt_issued_at < closure_evidence_anchored_entry.occurred_at <= final anchor observed_at <= envelope.valid_until_utc
closure_evidence_contract.pre_receipt_evaluator: evaluate_closure_bundle deterministically evaluates the complete or prefix-only closure artifacts, strict postrun_attested_facts and all pre-receipt external documents through the authorization-consumed anchor; it returns an unsigned receipt projection and does not read, sign or hash a closure receipt or final ledger entry
closure_evidence_contract.final_closed_campaign_verifier: verify_closed_campaign fully reruns evaluate_closure_bundle only for normal publication disposition; quarantine paths validate signed receipt facts and the final witnessed anchor but do not claim to revalidate unavailable quarantined bytes
closure_evidence_contract.persisted_live_evidence_validation_conte: pure read-only context derived from an offline_validation surface selection plus the signed envelope, authorization grant and execution bindings; it validates already-persisted records only

seen_manifest_exact_cross_projection.manifest.exclusion_digest_set_count: envelope.task_custody.seen_task_exclusion_set_count and custodian in-memory exact union cardinality used for overlap computation

new_unseen_attestation.source_snapshot_commitment: SHA256(UTF8(seen_task_exclusion_set_domain) || 0x00 || ASCII(source_class) || 0x00 || canonical_json(sorted unique lowercase canonical-case digests for that source class))
new_unseen_attestation.allowed_wording: external custodian attested and committed the synthetic task bundle after candidate freeze and before authorization; exact canonical digest overlap with the enumerated seen-task exclusion set was zero

claim_boundary.verified_privacy_scope: closure bundle, signed receipts, external ledger documents and explicitly declared project artifacts only
